name: sfml
description: Tooling for the SFML specification, its JSON Schema, and its conformance suite.

scripts.render:mermaid: node tools/sfml-to-mermaid.mjs .sfml/factory.sfml --out .sfml/factory.mmd && node tools/sfml-to-mermaid.mjs conformance/parser/full/factory.sfml --out tools/sfml-to-mermaid.test.full.mmd
scripts.test: npm run validate:schema && npm run validate:conformance && npm run test:example && npm run lint:factory && npm run test:tools
